question: Whose concurrence is needed for a consultant's scope of work?
gold_answer: The department's ACS/PS/Secretary, not DIT (corrigendum 19-03-2021). Not changed by a later GR in this corpus

gold_grs_detail.title: Regarding Empanelment of Consultants for IT Projects in Government of Maharashtra.

product.answer: According to the Government Resolution dated 20-03-2018, departments need to finalize the scope of work for consultancy with the concurrence of DIT.
